## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      10 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 7 jul 2026 - 18 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _hjgjkhfhgdsdfhgjklhfhdsrueytiu_, 18 sept 2026, 1/5: "As a pro user for the last few years, it’s a shame to see forest just keep going downhill - from adding AI slop trees, constant buggy updates, and now finally the new UI which makes returning to the home screen after planting a tree multiple clicks, I’m writing a review to hopefully get things to change. It’s a big shame, I hope they get their act together and remember what the core idea about the app is about."
            2. _Silk14789_, 16 sept 2026, 1/5: "The developers have forced a buggy and fastidious update that ruins the app for me. It seems they went for sth “aesthetic” and forgot this a productivity app. At least give us the option to use the old UI back!"
            3. _Garv Malani_, 14 sept 2026, 1/5: "the concept is excellent, helping me a lot, but the app is not that great. It feels very slow and every response is delayed. Hope you all will fix it soon"
<!--/ir-theme-->
